text:
marta: heads up — trying the new starter sample after accepting the org SSO invite and the ToS. first call just fails with a 403 and no helpful text.

marta: error payload from the client: `{"error":"workspace_billing_required","message":"Please add billing before first call"}`

onboard-bot: Hi @marta — your workspace needs a billing method to enable hosted inference. You can add one at https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/abc123/billing :card_with_heart:

marta: thanks — weird thing is the sample app UI just shows a generic "request failed (403)" toast, nothing about billing. new users won't know where to go.

devon: can you paste the exact steps you did? (which quickstart, env, whether you used service account or browser OAuth)

marta: cloned https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-sample, `npm i && npm run dev`, accepted invite via Okta SSO, clicked accept ToS. App shows welcome; when I hit "Run example" it errors. Using browser OAuth flow (no service token).

devon: got it. likely two things: (1) server-side response includes the billing code but the client UI doesn't map it to an actionable message, (2) our quickstart doesn't handle 403 with `workspace_billing_required` and show the billing console link.

devon: quick workaround — use a service API key locally so the quickstart bypasses workspace gating. export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<your-service-key>

devon: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}'
```

marta: ok that works. but for onboarding UX we should show a better message in the browser flow.

samir: @devon @marta I agree — this is a DX regression. I'll prioritize a small fix: detect `workspace_billing_required` in the client and show a modal with the billing console link + next steps for new orgs.

samir: opened PR #478 to the starter-sample: adds mapping for billing error codes -> actionable copy, and retry hint. ETA: end of day tomorrow. :shipit:

devon: also adding a server-side header `x-redwood-why` with value `billing_required` in the response for easier client mapping — will follow up in the API playbook.

marta: thanks! that should prevent dozens of confused first-call users.

marta: for tracking — please add a short note in the onboarding docs about SSO invite timing vs billing enablement. I hit this because we provisioned SSO invite before billing was attached.

samir: good call. I'll add a line to the quickstart README and the console onboarding checklist.

marta: verified the service key workaround and unblocked my testing. will re-test once PR lands. :thumbsup:

devon: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until PR merged and docs updated.
